description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order KAATSU  - Highly Advanced Medical Technology Training Center (Pvt.) Limited (KIU)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the Minister exercising powers under the Universities Act to amend regulations governing degree programs and admission qualifications for private higher education institutions. It constitutes a regulatory order under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
